headline: Yevhen Plynskyi: "Security umbrella" collapsed over the State Tax Service: NABU exposed tax corruption schemes
summary: Commentary by Yevhen Plynskyi says NABU's exposure of corruption schemes at the State Tax Service (DPS) raises questions about how deeply law enforcement will investigate it.
why: Tax administration integrity affects revenue collection and the business environment, which matter for Ukraine's finances and donor support.
